name: content-engine-by-ruby
description: Brand-neutral AI content engine. Research competitors/trends, plan a calendar (blog + video), draft long-form blogs, generate Canva clickbait images + Higgsfield videos, write per-platform social posts (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest), publish via Make.com with automatic cheap fallback (Upload-Post), and optimize for Google SEO. Everything reads from config/brand.json.
